page: Microsoft Azure ND96isr_H200_v5 is an isolated, RDMA-capable virtual machine belonging to the NDISRH200V5 server family. It is powered by an Intel processor with an x86_64 architecture, featuring 96 dedicated vCPUs managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is equipped with 1850.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 19.27 GB of RAM per core.

For acceleration and storage-heavy tasks, the server integrates 8.0 GPUs alongside a massive local storage array of 31769 GB on NVMe SSDs. It is premium storage capable and supports RDMA networking, which facilitates high-throughput, low-latency inter-node communication. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this instance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance represents a highly dense, premium hardware class designed for resource-intensive workloads. The combination of massive GPU acceleration, extensive NVMe storage, and isolated dedicated compute resources positions it for large-scale AI training, deep learning, complex simulations, and high-performance database workloads.
